description: Routed wire-harness CAD (a provider of the cad capability): each cable's 3D geometry (conductors swept along an obstacle-free route, twisted where the cable is, connector housings and solder joints) generated from the assembled UHD model and bound to the frames its ends land on.

skills.summary: Generate and bind a wire harness's routed 3D geometry from the assembled model; read the route report (length fit, bend radius, clearance) and fix what it finds

tools.purpose: Python with build123d, numpy and scipy (voxel routing, sweeps, STEP/GLB export)
probe: exec "${PROTOBOARD_PYTHON:-python3}" -c 'import build123d, numpy, scipy; print("build123d " + build123d.__version__)'
tools.install: protoboard tools install cad (a project venv with these pins), or point PROTOBOARD_PYTHON at an interpreter with build123d==0.13.0 numpy==2.5.3 scipy==1.18.1

capabilities.summary: Routed wire harnesses: an obstacle-free route through the assembled model, swept conductors, plug housings and solder joints (build123d)

generate.summary: Route the harness through the assembled model, around the cables routed before it in the system's order, and write harness-cad/route.json (conductor paths, length fit, bend limits, clearance)

export.summary: Build the bodies from harness-cad/route.json and write out/body.glb, body.step and body.manifest.json (end frames, lengths, bend radii, clearance)

extract.summary: The end frames the route was generated for, and the harness's artifacts

check.summary: The route is not older than the model, the export not older than the route; the cable fits its length, routed clear, and every end still meets its part

operations.summary: Alias of cad:generate then cad:export for every wire harness (or the named ones), each bound by its cad.config.ts, in one routing run

harness.description: comma-separated harness definition ids or instance paths (default: every wire harness with a cable_build trait)

operations.summary: Manufacturing Package: preparation of each routed cable in its unit's work order (cut length, strip, conductors, lay, bend radius, terminations)
Manufacturing Package: routing checks of each cable (bend radius, clearance, slack)

checks.summary: Wire harnesses that no cad.config.ts binds to a cad provider (each bound harness's route report is its cad:check)
